review_method: 사용자 제공 SEC 10-K·10-Q·8-K·Proxy·Form 4 8개 PDF의 원자료 추출과 초벌분석. 외부 시세·웹 자료는 사용하지 않음.
portfolio_context: 원자료 기반 초벌분석이며 신규 매수 승인·자동 매매·포지션 배정이 아니다.
structural_thesis: 광고 네트워크와 글로벌 배포망에 AI 추천·타게팅을 결합해 광고 단위수익을 높이는 동시에 AI/메시징/글래스 등 새 수익면을 여는 구조.
customer_and_moat: Q2 2026에는 DAP 3.60B, 광고 노출 +14%, 평균 광고가격 +12%가 동시에 나타났으나 광고주 ROI·경쟁 플랫폼 대비 유지율은 독립 검증이 필요.
current_finding: 핵심 광고 사업은 강하게 성장하지만 2026년 AI 인프라 투자가 급격히 자본집약적으로 바뀌며 Q2 회사정의 FCF가 $0.784B까지 압축됐다.
economic_finding: FY2025 회사정의 FCF $43.585B 대비 H1 2026 $13.170B. SBC를 현금대체비용으로 단순 차감한 진단값은 H1 -$0.520B, Q2 -$6.874B로, 주당 경제가치의 핵심 미해결 변수는 AI 투자 회수율이다.
capital_and_survival: 현금+유가증권 $90.26B와 H1 OCF $64.09B로 생존성은 강하지만 장기부채 $83.66B, 미개시 리스 $278.99B, 비취소 약정 $349.31B, 7월 추가 데이터센터 리스 $68B가 향후 현금고정비를 크게 늘린다.
next_evidence: AI 인프라 유지/성장 Capex와 리스의 투자회수, 광고주 ROI·코호트 유지, 완전희석 주식수/SBC, 동시점 가격의 reverse DCF
permanent_loss_case: 광고 해자는 유지되더라도 AI 인프라와 Reality Labs의 장기 현금수익률이 자본비용을 밑도는 가운데 고정 약정·희석·규제비용이 누적되어 주당 owner FCF가 구조적으로 낮아지는 경우
falsifiers: 광고 노출 또는 가격이 둔화하는 동시에 광고주 ROI/유지율이 악화해 AI 광고 개선 가설이 깨짐
AI 인프라 투자 증가가 2~3년 이상 증분 매출·마진·현금회수로 연결되지 않아 증분 ROIC가 9% 허들을 지속적으로 밑돎
주식수 증가와 SBC 경제비용이 환매를 지속적으로 초과해 FCF/share 성장률이 회사 FCF 성장률을 구조적으로 하회
Reality Labs 손실이 축소되지 않고 핵심 FoA 현금흐름의 약 20% 이상을 장기간 소모
increase_evidence: AI 인프라별 가동률·단위비용·광고/제품 매출 기여를 연결한 다년 증분 ROIC
4개 분기 이상 SBC 이후 주당 owner FCF 재가속과 순희석 안정화
독립 광고주 ROI/유지율과 경쟁 플랫폼 대비 engagement share 방어
9% 요구수익률 reverse DCF에서 현실적인 Base 이하 가정으로 충분한 기대차 확인
sell_evidence: 광고 해자 훼손과 AI 자본회수 부진이 동시 확인되어 owner FCF/share의 장기 하락 경로가 고착
대규모 추가 조달·희석이 핵심 사업 생존 또는 기존 인프라 약정 이행을 위해 필요해짐
경영진·회계 신뢰성 또는 법적 사업제약이 Hard Veto FAIL로 확정

evidence: Q2 2026 revenue grew 28% YoY while ad impressions rose 14% and average price per ad rose 12%; AI is already embedded in recommendation, ad targeting and measurement while Meta is also building new AI products.
counter_evidence: The company is already at enormous scale, most revenue still comes from Facebook/Instagram advertising, and structural growth may be partly offset by regulation, platform policy changes and lower-monetizing Reels/geographies.
missing_data: Independent advertiser ROI/retention evidence by cohort; AI product revenue outside advertising; long-run market-share data.

evidence: Advertising demand and price per ad both increased; management attributes price gains mainly to improved ad performance from targeting and measurement tools. DAP remained 3.60 billion.
counter_evidence: The filing does not independently quantify advertiser incremental ROAS, and privacy/platform changes can reduce signal quality and advertiser value.
missing_data: Independent ROAS/conversion studies; cohort retention and advertiser concentration.

evidence: Meta retained 3.60 billion Family DAP while increasing both ad impressions and price; first-party engagement and AI recommendation/ad systems can reinforce distribution and monetization.
counter_evidence: Meta explicitly cites competition for younger users, lower monetization of Reels, and regulatory/OS constraints on ad data signals.
missing_data: Independent engagement share versus TikTok/YouTube; advertiser switching economics; AI discovery impact by surface.

evidence: FY2025 company-defined FCF was $43.585B and FoA operating income was $102.469B, showing a powerful core cash engine.
counter_evidence: H1 2026 company-defined FCF fell to $13.170B and Q2 to $0.784B as capex intensity rose; subtracting SBC as a cash-equivalent diagnostic yields -$0.520B for H1 and -$6.874B for Q2. 2026 capex guidance is $130-145B.
missing_data: Maintenance versus growth capex; AI infrastructure utilization/revenue attribution; asset useful-life/depreciation bridge; multi-year FCF/share path.

evidence: 2025 buybacks more than offset gross share issuance and the FY2025 audit/internal-control opinions were unqualified; board added Risk & Strategy and Audit & Privacy committees and reports active AI oversight.
counter_evidence: No Class A repurchases occurred in H1 2026 while debt issuance and AI infrastructure commitments increased materially; Zuckerberg controlled 60.8% of voting power as of April 1, 2026, limiting minority-shareholder influence.
missing_data: Return hurdles for AI infrastructure and Reality Labs; repurchase discipline under elevated capex; related-party and strategic transaction economics.

evidence: At June 30, 2026 Meta held $90.26B of cash and marketable securities and generated $64.09B H1 operating cash flow; the core FoA segment remains highly profitable.
counter_evidence: Long-term debt reached $83.66B, uncommenced leases were $278.99B, non-cancelable commitments were $349.31B, and another $68B of data-center leases were signed in July.
missing_data: Maturity-by-maturity lease/capacity cash schedule and downside funding stress test under lower advertising growth.

evidence: Primary filings establish business economics and obligations but do not provide a synchronized market price or reverse-expectations model.
counter_evidence: Without current price, fully diluted economic share count and a 10-year cash model, no expectation-gap score is policy-compliant.
missing_data: Synchronized META price; diluted share/award bridge; reverse DCF using 9% hurdle; Bear/Base/Bull scenarios.

evidence: Meta has optionality in AI assistants/enterprise products, business messaging, glasses and other new surfaces on top of a global distribution base.
counter_evidence: At Meta's current scale, 10x-type outcomes require very large new profit pools; AI and Reality Labs optionality is capital intensive and not yet separately monetized in the supplied filings.
missing_data: Independent AI product monetization; long-run RL unit economics; price-based permanent-loss asymmetry.

evidence: FY2025 auditor issued unqualified opinions on financial statements and internal control over financial reporting; supplied filings show no restatement flag.
items.resolution_needed: Continue monitoring legal/regulatory matters and governance concentration; no current integrity FAIL evidence in supplied documents.

evidence: H1 2026 operating cash flow was $64.09B and cash plus marketable securities were $90.26B; core FoA remains strongly profitable.
items.resolution_needed: Stress-test whether the planned AI build can be paced without repeated debt issuance; this is an execution/funding question rather than a survival failure at present.

evidence: Combined shares rose from 2.530B at 2025 year-end to 2.548B at June 30, 2026; H1 had 32M shares issued, 14M withheld for net settlement, and no repurchases.
items.resolution_needed: Track gross grants/issuance, share withholding, repurchase funding and diluted share count over at least four quarters.

evidence: Q2 revenue growth was supported by both 14% ad-impression growth and 12% average-price-per-ad growth; DAP also grew 3%.
items.resolution_needed: Verify advertiser ROI and retention independently, but current supplied evidence does not show subsidy/financing-driven growth.

evidence: Capex including finance-lease principal rose to 51.1% of Q2 revenue and company-defined Q2 FCF fell to $0.784B while 2026 capex guidance reached $130-145B.
items.resolution_needed: Bridge AI infrastructure capex/leases to incremental revenue, operating profit and cash returns by cohort and useful life.

evidence: User scale, ad impressions and price are strong, but Meta cites younger-user competition, Reels' lower monetization and regulatory/OS signal restrictions.
items.resolution_needed: Measure engagement share, advertiser ROI/retention and AI recommendation monetization against competing platforms.

evidence: No synchronized market quote or reverse DCF is included in the supplied source set.
items.resolution_needed: Obtain current price and fully diluted share count, then reverse-engineer growth, margin, capex and duration using the 9% US hurdle.

evidence: Substantially all revenue is still generated from advertising on Facebook and Instagram, creating product/revenue and regulatory-platform dependence despite a diversified advertiser base.
items.resolution_needed: Quantify revenue concentration by surface/geography and sensitivity to privacy/OS restrictions; test whether business messaging/other revenue materially diversifies cash flow.

evidence: Core cash generation is strong, but fixed infrastructure commitments, legal/regulatory exposure and concentrated voting control can amplify a prolonged AI-capital-return shortfall.
items.resolution_needed: Run downside cash model including lease/contract commitments, normal tax rate, SBC and no heroic AI monetization; then compare with current price.

missing_data: fully diluted economic share count/award bridge

attacks: AI-driven ad improvements may be real, but current price could already capitalize most of the benefit; no expectation gap has been measured.
The company may be converting a historically asset-light ad model into a much more capital-intensive infrastructure model without equivalent incremental returns.
Company-defined FCF can look positive while SBC remains an economic compensation cost; H1 2026 SBC-adjusted diagnostic is slightly negative.
H1 2026 cash flow benefited from unusually low cash taxes and a tax benefit; normal cash taxes could reduce future cash conversion.
Reality Labs continues to consume about one-fifth of FoA operating income, and its long-term monetization is not yet demonstrated.
Data-center leases and contractual commitments can create quasi-fixed obligations that do not appear in headline capex until later periods.
Meta's ad moat depends partly on data signals, regulation and mobile operating systems it does not control.
Reels and growth in lower-monetizing geographies can lift engagement/impressions while diluting average monetization quality.
Zuckerberg's 60.8% voting control may allow long-duration capital allocation choices that minority shareholders cannot readily constrain.
Insider sales in the supplied Form 4s are preplanned 10b5-1 transactions and should not be overread; conversely, they provide no positive evidence on valuation.

missing: current synchronized price and reverse DCF

source_quality.primary_document_reaudit: Eight supplied SEC PDFs were inspected; extracted values are tied to filing/page locations and local SHA256 hashes.
source_quality.fact_estimate_inference_opinion: Raw filings and mechanical calculations are separated from analyst inference; company guidance is not treated as realized fact.
limitations: No external market quote or independent customer dataset was used.
Form 4 sales were preplanned 10b5-1 transactions and are not treated as valuation signals.
The SBC cash-equivalent FCF proxy is a diagnostic, not a complete owner-FCF model.

authority_note: 현재 registry/latest는 2026-09-06 권한 스냅샷을 유지한다. 이 파일은 raw evidence 기반 초벌분석이며 다음 canonical harness run 전까지 현재 판정을 대체하지 않는다.
